mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user ( user_id, username, password, user_name, email, role, use_yn, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{username}, #{password}, #{userName}, #{email}, COALESCE(#{role}, 'USER'), 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update:
UPDATE tb_user
password = #{password},
user_name = #{userName},
email = #{email},
updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user_token ( user_id, refresh_token, expiry_date, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{refreshToken}, #{expiryDate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET refresh_token = EXCLUDED.refresh_token, expiry_date = EXCLUDED.expiry_date, created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS "userId", refresh_token AS "refreshToken", expiry_date AS "expiryDate" FROM tb_user_token WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND refresh_token = #{refreshToken}
